title: Funds Disbursed under Young Entrepreneurs Scheme for Schools Programme
what_it_is: Funds Disbursed under Young Entrepreneurs Scheme for Schools Programme

sections.label: YES! grant disbursement to schools
sections.summary: From October 2008 to 2016, about $4.3 million went to 149 schools, with over 40,000 students in YES! entrepreneurship activities.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: Schools was launched in October 2008 till 2016, about $4.3 million has been disbursed to 149 unique schools, of which 95 schools have been awarded the grant more than once.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: Of the unique schools, 64 are Primary schools, 79 are Secondary schools and JCs, and the remaining six are ITE colleges and Polytechnics.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: On average, about $184,000 has been disbursed to Primary schools annually, $270,000 to Secondary schools and JCs, and $87,000 to Polytechnics and ITE colleges.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Trade and Industry (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: So far, more than 40,000 students have participated directly in entrepreneurship learning activities conducted by the schools under the YES!

sections.label: School participation in YES! Programme
sections.summary: Since 2008, 64 Primary, 79 Secondary and JC, and six ITE and Polytechnic institutions have joined the YES! Programme.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Programme since it was launched in 2008: 64 Primary schools, and that would be 35% of Primary schools; 79 Secondary schools, and that would be slightly more than half of Secondary schools; and six ITE, Polytechnics, which means four out of five Polytechnics, are already on board, bearing in mind they also have their own respective Elective Modules or Advance Elective Modules.

sections.label: SPRING and MOE youth entrepreneurship
sections.summary: Based on eight years of experience, SPRING Singapore will continue working with MOE, schools and PSEIs to nurture youth entrepreneurship.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Suffice to say that based on the last eight years of experience, SPRINGSingapore will certainly continue to work with MOE, schools and also the PSEIs to nurture an enterprising spirit and entrepreneurial mindset in our youth and ensure that those whose interest in entrepreneurship has been sparked will continue to have various pathways to nurture that interest.

sections.label: Risk management in YES! programmes
sections.summary: Under YES! programmes, students learn entrepreneurship, innovation, opportunity recognition, risk management, cutting losses and managing resources.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Indeed, knowing how to manage risks is a very important part of entrepreneurship and innovation.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Under the YES! programmes, there are various platforms where students will be given some understanding of entrepreneurship and innovation, developing the ability to be enterprising, resourceful and innovate and persevere under difficult circumstances, and also the ability to recognise opportunities and how to manage risks, and even to cut loss and manage the resources – bearing in mind that we live in a resource-constrainted world.
